role: CI gate: every http(s) host literal in app/watch Swift must be on a reviewed allowlist; no analytics/crash SDK names in pbxproj/Package.resolved; no Zip import/unzip call and no Polar firmware-update API (CVE-2023-39135 reachability).
toplevel: cd to repo root. Python: ALLOWED host set; URL regex over every line (comments included) of Emuqu/Sources and the watch app; unknown hosts -> exit 1. Then grep BANNED SDK names in project.pbxproj and Package.resolved (count != 0 -> exit 1). Then grep `^import Zip$` / Zip.unzipFile etc. (hit -> exit 1) and updateFirmware/firmwareUpdate/PolarFirmwareUpdate (hit -> exit 1). Line 87 is a Python print() call listed as a unit by the inventory. Wired: gates.yml (no-phone-home), ci.yml, Makefile.

flags.text: Host detection only sees literal `http(s)://host` text; a host assembled with URLComponents/host strings or a user-supplied custom base URL is invisible to it. The Python URL scan only reads Emuqu/Sources, while the Zip/firmware greps read all of Emuqu (including EmuquApp.swift).

units.does: Not a shell function: a Python `print()` statement (blank line) inside the embedded host-allowlist Python, after the unknown-host listing; misdetected by the inventory as a shell function.
